name: Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-SLP 'Diplomat'
description:
The Arcturus Defense Solutions ARC-SLP is a smart-linked compact pistol chambered in 9x19mm, designed specifically for executive protection details who operate in social environments where overt weapons are inappropriate. The weapon's profile is deliberately minimized — thin slide, flush sights, recessed controls — and the frame is finished in a matte gray that doesn't catch light or draw attention under clothing.

The Diplomat's BCI integration is tuned for the specific challenges of protection work in crowded social environments. The threat detection system is optimized for close-range engagement in dense civilian clusters, providing the shooter with precision guidance that minimizes collateral risk. The system can distinguish between a reaching-for-a-weapon motion and a reaching-for-a-glass motion with ninety-two percent accuracy — a capability that has prevented multiple misidentification incidents during field deployment.

Arcturus developed the Diplomat after a high-profile incident where an executive's bodyguard discharged a conventional weapon in a crowded reception, killing a bystander. The project mandate was simple: build a weapon that makes sure the right person gets shot and nobody else does. The result is the most expensive compact 9mm pistol ever manufactured, and every Spire protection detail wants one.
legality: Restricted — requires BCI registration and executive protection license

tactical_use: A precision smart-linked compact pistol for executive protection in social environments. The crowd-safe targeting system reduces collateral risk by providing the shooter with real-time assessment of bystander positions and shot angles. The minimized profile enables concealment under formal attire. Optimized for close-range precision rather than extended engagement.
cultural_context: The Diplomat is invisible by design — its entire purpose is to not exist until the moment it's needed. In Spire social circles, the knowledge that every protection detail likely carries one creates an undercurrent of carefully managed tension at high-profile events. The weapon embodies the Spires' approach to violence: precise, controlled, and never acknowledged until it's over.
story_hooks: A Diplomat's crowd-safe AI malfunctions during a reception and flags every person in the room as a threat simultaneously, causing the protection detail to evacuate their principal in a panic. The malfunction was not random.
An executive's protection detail member goes rogue and uses the Diplomat to assassinate their own principal — the crowd-safe system ensuring that no witnesses in the packed ballroom were harmed.

physical_description.visual_profile: A deliberately understated compact pistol with a razor-thin slide and absence of aggressive styling. The Diplomat's entire design language whispers rather than shouts—no tactical rails, no external safeties, no pronounced controls. Its silhouette resembles a dress watch translated into steel and polymer. The weapon's subtlety is its defining characteristic.
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light at 0.62kg—lighter than a full drink glass. Feels balanced between thumb and forefinger, designed for one-handed manipulation even in formal wear or confined spaces. Never feels ungainly or front-heavy despite its precision internals.
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy frame with carbon-composite slide. Internal components utilize hardened steel with ceramic wear surfaces for BCI sensor integration.
physical_description.finish: Matte gray with near-invisible brushed texturing that defeats both light reflection and fingerprinting. The finish is so subtle it appears to absorb light rather than deflect it. No shine, no shine whatsoever—deliberately designed to disappear against any environment.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dove gray primary with minimal accent work. Ultra-subtle graphite inlays along the slide serrations. No logos visible from more than arm's length.
physical_description.grip_texture: Micro-dimpled polymer with embedded conductive tracery for BCI hand-positioning feedback. The texture is almost imperceptible—feels like holding slightly textured ceramic rather than traditional grip tape. Warm to the touch due to integrated biometric sensors.
distinctive_features: Recessed, flush-mount rear sights that sit level with the slide
Absence of an external safety mechanism (BCI-managed)
Minimal trigger guard geometry—designed for gloved operation
Barely-visible neural interface port beneath the trigger housing
Integrated biometric sensor array along the grip
Subdued slide serrations that catch no light
Magazine well milled to exact tolerance with zero play
Witness holes showing round count on magazine
Custom contoured grip angle optimized for 92% accuracy scenario
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo (a minimal constellation pattern) etched into the left frame, visible only under direct inspection. Model designation 'ARC-SLP' stamped discretely on the right slide. Serial number on the frame, not the slide. No other branding—registration is entirely BCI-linked.
physical_description.condition_typical: Immaculate. The Diplomat is religiously maintained by professional operators. Any visible wear is cosmetic—minor slide racking marks, the matte finish developing a barely-perceptible patina from handling. Well-maintained examples appear virtually unused because they see infrequent deployment. When fired, the weapon operates with surgical precision.
